# ADR-3210: AWS encryption: TLS in transit required key for service link 2

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Cleartext AWS service calls expose data.

## Decision

Service links SHALL set a TLS in transit required key for service link 2 (AWS-encryption-2).

## Consequences

SDK minimum TLS is enforced.
